name: human
description: A CLI and REST interface for asking, notifying, or requesting a decision from a real person over Telegram, Slack, or email.
whenToUse: An autonomous or scheduled agent needs information and nobody is watching its terminal.
A risky or irreversible action requires explicit human approval.
A consequential choice should be selected by a person instead of guessed.
Long-running work should notify a person when it finishes.
whenNotToUse: The user is active in the current conversation and can answer directly.
The agent can make the decision safely from existing instructions.
The calling system already surfaces the same status.

capabilities.name: ask
capabilities.description: Ask a freeform question and wait for a text response.

capabilities.name: approve
capabilities.description: Request an explicit approval or denial with stable exit codes.

capabilities.name: choose
capabilities.description: Present two to ten options and wait for a selection.

capabilities.name: tell
capabilities.description: Deliver a one-way notification without waiting.
